history.summary: Frasers/Sekisui East Coast waterfront (2021) with a confirmed value gap and a live MRT catalyst: asking $2,054 psf for a 560 sqft 1BR vs a matching 560 sqft unit that sold at $2,213 psf (Dec-2025) and 1BRs trading $2,190-$2,220 — a real ~7-8% discount.
history.rating_rationale: Verification supports the algo's -12.0% age-adj cheapness and -6.3% vs-cohort discount on solid depth (172 appreciation txns, 19 cohort txns). A like-for-like 560 sqft 1BR transacted at $2,213 psf in Dec-2025, a 506 sqft at $2,192 psf in Jan-2026, and small units broadly traded $2,190-$2,220 psf into early 2026 (project average ~$2,389-$2,474 psf in 2025-26). The asking $2,053 psf is clearly below the directly comparable 560 sqft print — genuine value, not a quirk. The Siglap TEL MRT station (3-min walk) is now operational, a concrete connectivity catalyst the v3.4 priors reward. D15 is RCR (realized fwd ~+3.5%). Developer JV (Frasers Centrepoint / Sekisui House / Keong Hong), 2021 completion, established East Coast lifestyle. High confidence given a verified discount on an identical unit size plus a dated, now-live MRT catalyst.
red_flags: Some inbuilt appliances reported as poor quality with bugs by residents — budget for replacements
Sea-facing/ECP-adjacent stacks carry highway noise; non-sea stacks lose the view premium — verify this unit's facing
Small 1BR competes within a large 843-unit project with a deep small-unit pool
catalysts: Siglap MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line) now operational, 3-min walk — ~20 min to city
Long-term Greater Southern Waterfront and East Coast rejuvenation
Established East Coast lifestyle/amenity draw underpinning rental demand
